name: threads-scraper
title: Threads Scraper — Posts, Profiles, Hashtag & Keyword Search
description: One actor, five Threads scraping modes: user profiles, hashtag topics, keyword search, single posts with replies, and custom feeds. Bulk-paste up to 100 usernames or keywords, relative-date filters ("7 days", "1 month"), full engagement metrics (likes, replies, reposts, shares, views, quotes), ISO timestamps, media URLs. No login, no API token. Flat $0.005 per result, no start fee.
